kind: Real HEAD/current MediaViewModel source, real MVVM toolkit; ImageSource type shim only, synthetic preallocated input records, no WinUI/native execution or render timing.

conditions.inputRecords: 300 preallocated timeline records (33 ms increments; fixed title/player/duration/bounds/capabilities) and 300 preallocated loopback frames (fixed bands, changing revision).
conditions.allocationCounter: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread; same process/runtime/thread, warmed real source implementations, second isolated instance.

validation.countBasis: 14 distinct focused cases: 8 existing lyric publication/display tests, 5 new notification scenario tests, 1 same-process HEAD/current measurement; amended capability and publication cases rerun individually.

limitations: No native Windows/WinUI runtime execution, XAML generation/complete App build or UI responsiveness/CPU/frame measurements.
The pure tests link all actual Core sources and the actual ViewModel; only ImageSource type uses a Linux stub.

The WinUI reference C# build uses real Microsoft.WinUI/Windows targeting references and temporary generated field stubs, so it checks C# surface compatibility, not XAML generation or runtime behavior.
AllocatedBytes reports managed allocation for these synthetic records and counting subscribers only; it is not whole-app memory or a latency measurement.

finalSource.note: Repository CRLF normalization only after validation; current.sha256 retains bytes from the measurement. No semantic source change.
